espn_id.description: Copied from the packet. Must match, or the dossier is discarded.

verdict.description: clean: no meaningful history. watch: missed time but available. concern: recurring or unresolved. out: not expected to play.

detail.description: Games missed by season, injury type, whether it recurs, current practice status.

news_since.description: Dated items since 2026-08-20. Empty is a fine answer.

date.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Enforced: the first run returned '2026-02' for February news, which is neither a date nor 'since 2026-08-20'.

direction.description: Is ESPN's projection stale high, stale low, or fair?

multiplier.description: Applied to the player's projection and clamped to the same band in code. 1.0 unless news earns otherwise.

veto.description: True only for a player who should not be rostered at any price.

confidence.description: high only when the record is dated, sourced and current.

sources.description: Every URL actually retrieved. Validated as real URLs in code.
